status: Operator-directed attachment models; existing recovery formula retained.

modelDecisions.compensator: Existing 10-point entry already matches Flash Comp with normal 54 m world spotting and 150 m minimap spotting; Linear Comp remains separate.
modelDecisions.hybrid_supp_l: Long Suppressor recovery/spotting/sway, one recoil improvement tier, one total hip-fire penalty tier, one draw penalty tier; 30 points.
modelDecisions.hybrid_supp_s: Lightened Suppressor recovery/spotting, one recoil improvement tier, one total hip-fire penalty tier; 40 points.
modelDecisions.hybrid_supp_k: Lightened Suppressor recovery/spotting, one recoil improvement tier, no hip-fire penalty; 50 points.
modelDecisions.canted_vertical: Two hip-fire improvement tiers and two draw improvement tiers; 30 points. Operator reports L110 sprint recovery changes from 350 to 267 ms, matching primary ladder indices 8 to 6.

availabilityBasis: Existing Frosty attachment/ability selector records, mapped by retained weapon identities. Operator screenshots confirm attachment identity and prices. This is not a per-weapon live menu audit.
limitations: Tier models are operator-directed, not newly decoded native mechanics. Existing recoil recovery estimate metadata is inherited from the selected suppressor models.
